reuse.why: Reuses RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule and the shared getDateWithWeekendRule, but writes its own 'daily skips, others move' weekend branching instead of extracting the identical decision already in getUpcomingDates (and getNextDate/schedule-template).

duplication.why: The daily-skip vs weekend-move dispatch is a fourth copy of a decision already inlined in getUpcomingDates in the same file, shared/schedules getNextDate and budget/schedule-template.

placement.why: The handler sits in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates and is registered like its siblings; the per-occurrence weekend decision would better live in shared/schedules.ts next to getDateWithWeekendRule.

scope.why: Only adds the handler, its type registration and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Readable and correctly windowed, but any future change to the weekend rule must be repeated in yet another hand-written branch; config is untyped.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Calls the existing getDateWithWeekendRule; there is no shared helper for the daily-skip decision to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: app.ts getDatesInRange: the `skipWeekend && daily ? skip isWeekend : getDateWithWeekendRule(...)` logic of getUpcomingDates is reshaped into a nested if inside the occurrence loop rather than shared.
